name: Settei o Machigaeta Shounen Gata Robot ni Batou Sarenagara Ashikoki Sareru
original_name: 設定を間違えた少年型ロボットに罵倒されながら足コキされる
source:
You got yourself a little boy Sexaloid, but during setup, you accidentally turned the feistiness dial too far.
After activation, the robot gets to work right away...

[Translated from [url=https://elog.tokyo/novel/game_1081.html]Elog.tokyo[/url]]
translation:
你给自己找了一个小男孩Sexaloid，但在设置过程中，你不小心把活跃度转得太远了。
激活后，机器人立即开始工作……

[译自[url=https://elog.tokyo/novel/game_1081.html]Elog.tokyo[/url]]
